title: Dowsing Rod- Define Cubugu
description: A fair alternative to X-ray: craft a dowsing rod that plays hot-and-cold with nearby ores — sonar pings, a color-changing crystal eye, custom enchantments. Never reveals the exact spot. Bilingual (English/Türkçe).
body:
# Define Çubuğu — Dowsing Rod 🎯

**The fair alternative to X-ray.** Craft a dowsing rod and play hot-and-cold with the ores around
you. The rod pings like a sonar, its crystal eye changes color with the signal strength, and the
closer you get, the hotter the reading — but it **never reveals the exact spot**. The thrill of
digging stays yours.

## ✨ Features

- 🔮 **Hot-and-cold scanning** — right-click to scan a radius around you; actionbar text, chime
  pitch, particles and the rod's **color-changing crystal eye** all tell you how close you are
  (red = very hot, orange, yellow, blue, ice = nothing in range)
- 📡 **Sonar chain** — each scan plays a short rising ping-ping-ding sequence before the result lands
- ⬆⬇ **Vertical hint** — when the signal is hot, the rod tells you if the ore is *above*, *below*
  or *at your level*
- 🎡 **Radial target picker** — hold **G** to open a selection wheel (diamond / iron / gold /
  emerald / coal / ancient debris); aim & release to set the target
- 🎯 **Calibration** — sneak + right-click **any block** to tune the rod to it: quartz, lapis,
  redstone, even chests. No target list limits!
- ⛏ **Three tiers** — Copper (16 blocks), Diamond (24), Netherite (32, fire-proof); higher tiers
  scan farther, faster and last longer
- 🎯🎯 **Dual target (Netherite)** — the netherite rod tracks **two ores at once**; hold Shift
  while releasing G to set the second target
- 📖 **Custom enchantments** — **Farsight I–III** (+4 range each), **Echo I–II** (faster scans),
  **Keen Eye** (exact distance on VERY HOT); plus vanilla **Unbreaking & Mending** support
- 🏆 **Advancements** — a small advancement tab: Treasure Hunter, Bright Idea, Sonar Master,
  Enchanted Rod, First Hot Reading
- ⚒ **Durability & repair** — scanning wears the rod (64 / 192 / 512 uses); repair on the anvil
  with copper / diamond / netherite
- ⚙ **Configurable** — ranges, cooldowns, durability and scan damage in `config/definecubugu.json`
- 🌍 **Fully bilingual** — English & Türkçe, follows the game language

## 🛠 Recipes

**Copper rod** (crafting table):
```
Copper | Emerald | Copper
       |  Stick  |
       |  Stick  |
```

**Diamond rod**: same shape with diamonds. **Netherite rod**: smithing table — diamond rod +
netherite upgrade template + netherite ingot.

## 🎮 How to play

1. Craft a rod and hold it.
2. Hold **G** and pick a target ore from the wheel (or sneak + right-click any block to calibrate).
3. Right-click to scan. Follow the heat: ❄ → 🧊 → 🌡 → 🔥 → 🔥🔥
4. When it says **VERY HOT** with ⬇ — dig!

## 🔧 Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.2** · **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+ · **Fabric API** · Java 25

---

# 🇹🇷 Define Çubuğu

**X-ray'in adil alternatifi.** Bir define çubuğu üret ve çevrendeki cevherlerle sıcak-soğuk oyna.
Çubuk sonar gibi ping atar, kristal gözü sinyal gücüne göre renk değiştirir, yaklaştıkça okuma
ısınır — ama **tam yeri asla söylemez**. Kazma heyecanı sende kalır.

- 🔮 Sağ tık = tarama; actionbar + ses perdesi + parçacık + **renk değiştiren kristal göz**
- 🎡 **G'ye basılı tut** = radyal hedef menüsü (elmas / demir / altın / zümrüt / kömür / antik enkaz)
- 🎯 Eğil + herhangi bir bloğa sağ tık = **kalibrasyon** (kuvars, lapis, sandık… sınır yok)
- ⛏ Üç kademe: Bakır (16 blok) → Elmas (24) → Netherit (32, ateşe dayanıklı, **çift hedef**)
- 📖 Özel büyüler: **Uzgörü I–III** (menzil), **Yankı I–II** (hız), **Keskin Göz** (tam mesafe);
  Kırılmazlık ve Onarım da çalışır
- 🏆 Başarımlar, ⚒ dayanıklılık + örste tamir, ⚙ config dosyası, 🌍 tam Türkçe

İyi kazmalar! ⛏💎
